gloss: heavy drinking; being soaked in alcohol

definitions.gloss: heavy drinking; being soaked in alcohol; alcoholism
definitions.explanation: A state of being constantly drunk or habitually drinking heavily. Describes a lifestyle dominated by alcohol consumption, with strongly negative connotations.

examples.japanese: {定年後|ていねんご}、{酒浸|さけびた}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: After retirement, he spends every day soaked in alcohol.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{酒浸|さけびた}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷惑|めいわく}→迷惑：02432_meiwaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: My father was a heavy drinker and caused trouble for the family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失業|しつぎょう}→失業：03179_shitsugyou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{酒浸|さけびた}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}り→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧、⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{害|がい}した→害する：27887_gaisuru⟧。
examples.english: After losing his job, he fell into a life of heavy drinking and damaged his health.

notes:
{酒浸|さけびた}り literally means 'soaked in alcohol' and describes a state of habitual heavy drinking.

FORMS:
⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧ (alcohol) + {浸|びた}り (soaked, immersed). The ～{浸|びた}り pattern indicates being immersed in something to excess.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酒浸|さけびた}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧ (days spent drinking heavily)
- {酒浸|さけびた}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (a life of heavy drinking)
- {酒浸|さけびた}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become a heavy drinker)
- {酒浸|さけびた}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壊|こわ}す→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧ (ruin one's health through heavy drinking)

CONNOTATION:
Always negative. Describes problem drinking that dominates a person's life, not social or occasional drinking. Often used when describing someone whose life has deteriorated due to alcohol.

RELATED WORDS:
- {大酒飲|おおざけの}み: heavy drinker (can be neutral or even admiring in some contexts)
- ⟦アルコール→アルコール：01771_arukooru⟧⟦{依存症|いぞんしょう}→依存症：17964_izonshou⟧: alcoholism (medical/clinical term)
- {飲|の}んだくれ: drunkard (colloquial, derogatory)
